sayLines.line: Filled 1L (clean — Haven well). 3L carried (3kg). (-10 kcal hauling, 1 tick.) Cistern: 24L left.
"You haven't earned that yet," A man, maybe 40s, with a limp says. (Trust too low.)

Travel 1 tile to meadow.
— Open ground —
The grass is bent in a long smooth run, like something heavy slid through it. You walk the other way around.
Unfamiliar unknown berries — into the bag. (Unknowns lump together; sort them at camp.)
Journal: Disturbed ground grows good weeds.
The System notes the synergy — foraged a plant new to this ground: +1 field XP.
📓 Journal: you UNDERSTAND Green Thumb, Literally. It resonates with: something unnamed, something unnamed.
A shot in the dark — you take what's green: 5× unknown berries. Into the bag, unnamed. (Not food until identified — sort them at camp.) This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.

Travel 2 tiles to ruin.
— Pre-Burn ruin —
A gas station. The pumps are sculptures now. Nothing combustible within miles — the Burn was thorough.
📓 Journal: you UNDERSTAND Scrounger. It resonates with: something unnamed.
You pry open a cupboard: Canned beans (+650 kcal). Dusty can, intact seal. Someone's pantry, a lifetime ago.

Travel 2 tiles to forest floor.
— Under the canopy —
Leaf litter, birdcall, the smell of rot becoming soil. The woods, being the woods.
Something moves out there — a toad like a war drum, throat swelling.
Unfamiliar unknown nuts — into the bag. (Unknowns lump together; sort them at camp.)
Unfamiliar unknown nuts — into the bag. (Unknowns lump together; sort them at camp.)
Journal: Deep shade. The floor keeps its secrets.
Journal updated: a tree with compound leaves and hard nuts grows here too — better than a tree with lobed leaves and oval nuts in scaly caps.

A shot in the dark — you take what's green: 3× unknown nuts, 3× unknown nuts. Into the bag, unnamed. (Not food until identified — sort them at camp.) This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
📖 LEARNED: Old World Caches (Level 1). You know where people hid things: under floorboards, in hollow trees, behind loose bricks.
You've learned Old World Caches — it carries Eagle Eye.

Travel 2 tiles to trail edge.
— An old trail —
Where the trail crosses bare rock, someone scratched a mark — an arrow, or a tally, or a prayer. Pre-Burn. You add nothing. You remember it.
It followed you. The toad like a war drum is here.
Unfamiliar unknown berries — into the bag. (Unknowns lump together; sort them at camp.)
Journal: Trampled ground. The humble weeds win.
A shot in the dark — you take what's green: 5× unknown berries. Into the bag, unnamed. (Not food until identified — sort them at camp.) This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
📋 A woman, maybe 60s wants to know what's by the creek. "Just look. Come back and tell me."
Travel 1 tile to Haven.
The toad like a war drum stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
Someone by the fire nods at your pack. "We pool food here. Keep what you need for the road — the rest feeds everyone."
You keep a day's food (1400 kcal) and unload 650 kcal into Haven's pantry.
2 unprocessed hauls onto the counter — the clock is ticking.
Nobody at the fire knows your haul any better than you do. It'll be your own hands that teach you.
You walk back into Haven. 2 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
A man, maybe 40s, with a limp heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." The pantry won't fill itself.
A person, maybe 40s, with a long braid heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." The pantry won't fill itself.
A person, maybe 30s heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." The pantry won't fill itself.
A person, maybe 40s, with a buzz cut heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
A man, maybe 40s, with a slouched posture heads out to forage. "Gone looking. Don't wait up." The pantry won't fill itself.
A man, maybe 60s walks away from Haven. They don't look back.
A woman, maybe 50s, with deep-set eyes sets out to find A man, maybe 40s, with a slouched posture. "Won't be long." Company makes the road shorter.
A man, maybe 30s sets out to find A person, maybe 40s, with a long braid. "Won't be long." Company makes the road shorter.
A woman, maybe 60s is crouched over the embers, blowing soft, one hand blocking the draft. Better close to the fire today.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
You eat Dried meat (600 kcal).
A man, maybe 40s, with a limp shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
A man, maybe 40s, with a limp looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
💧 A man, maybe 40s, with a limp returns with water: +2 clean.
💧 A person, maybe 40s, with a buzz cut returns with water: +2 clean.
— NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.
The fire burns lower than it should. Nobody wants to be the one to go for wood in the dark.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
